# 1 Enoch Chapter 93 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch — Apocalypse of Weeks (Weeks 1–7)

---

**1** Then Enoch began to read from the books. He said: "I speak of the children of righteousness, of God's chosen ones, of the plant of uprightness that grows through the ages. What I tell you, my sons, I received in a heavenly vision. I learned it from the words of the holy angels. I read it on the heavenly tablets."

**2** Enoch read from the books and said:

"I was born in the seventh generation — the first week — when justice and righteousness still held the world together.

**3** After me, in the second week, terrible wickedness will rise and deception will take root. That week ends in the first catastrophe. One man will be rescued. After it is over, unrighteousness will surge back, and laws will be made specifically for sinners.

**4** Then, in the third week, near its end, a man will be chosen — the plant of righteous judgment. His descendants will become the eternal plant of righteousness.

**5** Then in the fourth week, near its end, visions of the holy and righteous will be given. A law for all generations will be established, and a sanctuary will be built for them.

**6** Then in the fifth week, near its end, a house of glory and power will be built to last forever.

**7** Then in the sixth week, everyone living in it will go blind — their hearts will abandon wisdom and turn completely godless. In that same week, a man will be taken up. And at its end, the house of dominion will be burned to the ground, and the entire chosen race will be scattered.

**8** Then in the seventh week — our own age — a generation of apostates will arise. Everything they do will be faithless.

**9** But near the end of that week, the elect — the righteous ones of the eternal plant — will be chosen. They will receive sevenfold instruction about all of God's creation.

**10** [For which of all the children of men can hear the voice of the Holy One without being shattered? Who can think his thoughts? Who can take in all the works of heaven?]

**11** Can anyone gaze into heaven and understand its mysteries? Has anyone seen a soul, a spirit, and lived to describe it? Has anyone climbed up to see where everything ends and come back to tell the tale?

**12** Which of all humanity knows the breadth and length of the earth? Who has been shown its measurements?

**13** Does anyone know the height of heaven, what it rests on, how many stars there are, where every light goes to sleep?

**14** [So this is what I tell you, my sons: love righteousness and live by it. The paths of righteousness lead somewhere worth going. The paths of unrighteousness will be suddenly destroyed and wiped from existence.]"

---

*PNEUMA notes: The Apocalypse of Weeks is history written from the future — a breathtaking compressed vision of all time. Week 3 (Abraham), Week 4 (Moses and Sinai), Week 5 (Solomon's Temple), Week 6 (Elijah's rapture + Babylonian exile and destruction of the Temple), Week 7 (the author's own fallen generation). The rhetorical questions (vv. 11–13) are not uncertainty — they are the awe of the seer who has been to the heights no other human reaches.*
